description: Deterministic domain risk and trust evaluation returning ALLOW / REVIEW / BLOCK. Uses DNS, RDAP, TLS, HTTP/redirect, URLhaus threat reputation, and local security indicators. Read-only: external read queries only, no action on the domain, no persistence, limited in-memory cache. USE WHEN: an agent needs to decide whether a domain is safe enough for interaction, onboarding, outreach, or payment. DO NOT USE WHEN: the agent needs consolidated domain health/operational inspection (use domain-agent-readiness-check) or validation of a specific email address (use email_validator_basic).

domain.description: Bare public hostname (e.g., example.com). No protocol, path, query, or fragment. Localhost and IP literals rejected.
